features.name: Bloodline
features.summary: Choose the supernatural bloodline that grants powers while bloodraging.

features.name: Bloodrage
features.summary: Enter a bloodrage for Strength, Constitution, and Will bonuses with an AC penalty.
features.uses: 4 + Constitution modifier rounds, +2 per later level

features.name: Fast Movement
features.summary: Gain +10 feet land speed while not in heavy armour or carrying a heavy load.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.summary: Retain Dexterity to AC while flat-footed and against invisible attackers.

features.name: Blood Sanctuary
features.summary: Gain a bonus on saves against spells cast by the Bloodrager or allies while bloodraging.

features.name: Blood Casting
features.summary: Cast Bloodrager spells even while bloodraging and ignore arcane spell failure in light or medium armour.

features.name: Eschew Materials
features.summary: Gain Eschew Materials as a bonus feat.

features.name: Improved Uncanny Dodge
features.summary: Cannot be flanked except by a sufficiently experienced sneak attacker.

features.name: Bloodline Feat
features.summary: Choose a bonus feat from the selected bloodline.

features.name: Damage Reduction
features.summary: Gain DR 1/—, improving by 1 every 3 Bloodrager levels.

features.name: Greater Bloodrage
features.summary: Bloodrage bonuses increase and entering bloodrage can apply a qualifying personal spell.

features.name: Indomitable Will
features.summary: Gain +4 on Will saves against enchantment spells while bloodraging.

features.name: Tireless Bloodrage
features.summary: No longer become fatigued when bloodrage ends.

features.name: Mighty Bloodrage
features.summary: Bloodrage bonuses increase again and entering it can apply a broader personal spell.
